title: Current-source root-cause and owner audit after Q03-A23

root_cause_reconciliation.historical_finding: Older Q01/Q02 evidence described the default route as Procedural-only with 17 visible fallback renderers.
root_cause_reconciliation.current_finding: After Q03-A23, the current default route installs the D20 Formal Humanoid consumer and hides the previous fallback renderers. D2 remains the physical-root and gameplay-action owner; D20 owns visible presentation consumption.
root_cause_reconciliation.implication: The older procedural action-distortion diagnosis is not a valid description of the current default visible route. It remains useful as the explicit -d2ProceduralPlayer fallback boundary, not as current default evidence.
remaining_visual_questions: Whether the Humanoid retargeted actions look natural in a compositor-visible Player
Whether swim/boarding/helm poses avoid clipping and preserve hand contact
Whether vegetation and harbor geometry are grounded from the gameplay camera
Whether W/S focus behavior is correct in a foreground native window

status_boundary: Q01 closes the current code/runtime owner and root-scale facts within connected Unity Pipeline scope. It does not close native foreground input, screenshots, subjective visual quality, no-clipping, vegetation grounding, or target-device performance.
